programs.name: suremel2dan
programs.purpose: Model elastic waves in a two-dimensional isotropic or anisotropic medium using Fourier spatial derivatives and rapid expansion time integration.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUREMEL2DAN - Elastic anisotropic 2D Fourier method modeling with high

params.name: amode
params.description: Select isotropic input with 0 or anisotropic input with a nonzero value.

params.name: isz
params.description: Vertical source grid indices; must match isx in length.

params.name: styp
params.description: Source types; must match isx in length.

params.name: samp
params.description: Source amplitudes; must match isx in length.

params.name: vmax
params.description: Global maximum velocity; required when amode is nonzero.

params.name: vmin
params.description: Global minimum velocity; required when amode is nonzero.

params.name: dtsnap
params.description: Snapshot time interval; zero disables snapshots.

params.name: sntyp
params.description: Snapshot types; required when dtsnap is nonzero.

params.name: sflag
params.description: Source time function: user wavelet, spike, or Ricker.

params.name: fmax
params.description: Ricker maximum frequency; required when sflag=2.

params.name: prec
params.description: Compute, save, or reuse Bessel coefficients.

params.name: irz
params.description: Vertical indices of horizontal receiver lines.

params.name: rxtyp
params.description: Horizontal receiver line types; required with irz and must have the same length.

params.name: irx
params.description: Horizontal indices of vertical receiver lines.

params.name: rztyp
params.description: Vertical receiver line types; required with irx and must have the same length.

params.name: jpfile
params.description: Diagnostic output file; absent selects stderr.

params.name: sname
params.description: User wavelet SU file when sflag=0.

params.name: amps
params.description: Listed in selfdoc but never read; actual source amplitudes use required samp.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Fourier transforms, iterative rapid-expansion and Bessel calculations, quadrature and sinc interpolation mix float and double and depend on accumulation order and platform math. The odd-grid checks use !nx % 2 and !nz % 2, whose precedence does not enforce the documented oddness requirement. Output is written to named SU files; model grids and optional Bessel coefficients are binary files.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines FFT-based elastic wave propagation, Bessel expansion, boundary conditions, multiple output files, and substantial state.

test_cases.description: Isotropic spike source and horizontal displacement section.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sugain scale=2000 | sustrip > vp && sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sugain scale=1000 | sustrip > vs && sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sustrip > dens && suremel2dan amode=0 nx=21 nz=21 nt=32 dx=10 dz=10 dt=0.001 isx=10 isz=10 styp=2 samp=1 sflag=1 iabso=0 irz=10 rxtyp=2

test_cases.description: Isotropic Ricker source with snapshots and a vertical section.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sugain scale=2000 | sustrip > vp && sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sugain scale=1000 | sustrip > vs && sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sustrip > dens && suremel2dan amode=0 nx=21 nz=21 nt=32 dx=10 dz=10 dt=0.001 isx=10 isz=10 styp=2 samp=1 sflag=2 fmax=20 iabso=0 irx=10 rztyp=3 dtsnap=0.01 sntyp=2

programs.license_note: Credits University of Hamburg, Ekkehart Tessmer, July 2013; cites Kosloff and colleagues' rapid expansion method.

programs.name: susyncz
programs.purpose: Generate zero-offset primary reflection seismograms for dipping interfaces in piecewise constant velocity layers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSYNCZ - SYNthetic seismograms for piecewise constant V(Z) function
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ray geometry, transmission coefficients and sinc interpolation use float arithmetic, accumulated contributions, and trigonometric and square-root functions. Supplied arrays are not checked for full length, so short arrays can leave elements uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program computes layered ray geometry and transmission coefficients and interpolates reflection impulses.

test_cases.description: Default layer geometry with a small trace set.
Parallel interfaces with explicit layer properties and repeated lines.
test_cases.command: susyncz nt=256 ntr=6 nline=2 dx=15 dt=0.004 tdelay=0.02 ninf=2 zint=100,250 dip=0,0 v=1500,2000,2500 rho=1,1.2,1.4

programs.name: susynlv
programs.purpose: Generate synthetic reflection seismograms for a linearly varying velocity model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSYNLV - SYNthetic seismograms for Linear Velocity function

params.name: kilounits
params.description: Input coordinates are in thousands of output coordinate units.

params.name: xo
params.description: Explicit signed offsets; overrides nxo, dxo and fxo.

params.name: nxo
params.description: Number of regularly sampled offsets when xo is absent.

params.name: dxo
params.description: Offset spacing when xo is absent.

params.name: fxo
params.description: First offset when xo is absent.

params.name: nxs
params.description: Number of shots when shot sampling is selected.

params.name: nxm
params.description: Number of midpoints; default geometry uses midpoints.

params.name: ref
params.description: Repeatable reflector specification decoded by decodeReflectors.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ray calculations, reflector discretization, sinc deposition and convolutions involve float accumulation and platform-dependent math. The shot and midpoint detection expressions short-circuit, though selected geometry parameters are subsequently reread.
programs.difficulty_reason: Reflector discretization, ray calculations, sinc deposition and convolution require numerical modeling and interpolation.

test_cases.description: Small midpoint gather with two explicit offsets.
test_cases.command: susynlv nt=128 dt=0.02 nxm=4 dxm=0.2 fxm=1 xo=0,0.2 'ref=1:0,1;3,1'

test_cases.description: Shot geometry with a gradient and non-default amplitude options.
test_cases.command: susynlv nt=128 dt=0.02 nxs=4 dxs=0.2 fxs=1 nxo=2 dxo=0.1 dvdz=0.2 ls=1 er=1 ob=0 smooth=1 'ref=1:0,1;1.5,1.2;3,1'

programs.name: susynlvcw
programs.purpose: Generate converted-wave synthetic reflection seismograms for a linearly varying velocity model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSYNLVCW - SYNthetic seismograms for Linear Velocity function

params.name: xo
params.description: Explicit signed offsets; overrides regular offsets.

params.name: nxs
params.description: Number of shots when shot sampling is selected.

params.name: ref
params.description: Repeatable reflector specification decoded by decodeReflectors.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Converted-wave ray calculations, reflector discretization, sinc deposition and convolution involve float accumulation and platform-dependent math.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program calculates two ray paths per reflector segment and applies interpolation and convolution.

test_cases.description: Converted-wave midpoint gather with explicit offsets.
test_cases.command: susynlvcw nt=128 dt=0.02 nxm=4 dxm=0.2 fxm=1 xo=0,0.2 gamma=0.6 'ref=1:0,1;3,1'

test_cases.description: Shot gather without spreading or obliquity.
test_cases.command: susynlvcw nt=128 dt=0.02 nxs=4 dxs=0.2 fxs=1 nxo=2 dxo=0.1 gamma=1.5 dvdz=0.2 ls=1 sp=0 ob=0 'ref=1:0,1;3,1'

programs.license_note: Based on Dave Hale's susynlv, modified by Mohammed Alfaraj for mode conversion.

programs.name: susynlvfti
programs.purpose: Generate synthetic reflection seismograms in a linearly varying, factorized transversely isotropic velocity model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSYNLVFTI - SYNthetic seismograms for Linear Velocity function in a

params.name: kilounits
params.description: Input coordinates are in thousands of output coordinate units.

params.name: xo
params.description: Explicit signed offsets; overrides regular offsets.

params.name: nxs
params.description: Number of shots when shot sampling is selected.

params.name: ntries
params.description: Maximum search iterations; selfdoc says 40, but code uses 20.

params.name: ref
params.description: Repeatable reflector specification decoded by decodeReflectors.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Anisotropic ray searches and travel-time integrations are iterative and tolerance-sensitive; trigonometric functions, float accumulation, sinc deposition and convolution can vary by platform. The code does not apply CHECK_NT to nt.
programs.difficulty_reason: Anisotropic ray tracing uses iterative searches and integration in addition to reflector modeling and convolution.

test_cases.command: susynlvfti nt=128 dt=0.02 nxm=4 dxm=0.2 fxm=1 nxo=1 epsilon=0.1 delta=0.05 verbose=0 'ref=1:0,1;3,1'

test_cases.description: Nonzero-offset shot geometry with a tilted symmetry axis.
test_cases.command: susynlvfti nt=128 dt=0.02 nxs=4 dxs=0.2 fxs=1 xo=0.1,0.2 angxs=10 a=1.1 f=0.4 l=0.3 ntries=20 nitmax=12 verbose=0 'ref=1:0,1;3,1'

programs.license_note: Credits T. Alkhallfah for the 1993 upgrade to transversely isotropic media.

programs.name: susynvxz
programs.purpose: Generate common-offset synthetic reflection seismograms from a two-dimensional velocity grid.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSYNVXZ - SYNthetic seismograms of common offset V(X,Z) media via

params.name: nxb
params.description: Width of the modeling band around the midpoint.

params.name: ref
params.description: Repeatable reflector specification decoded by decodeReflectors; coordinates must match the velocity-grid units.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Finite-difference travel-time and amplitude calculation, midpoint interpolation, reflector summation, sinc deposition and convolution are sensitive to float rounding and accumulation order. A short velocity-grid read calls err with a FILE pointer passed to a %s conversion, which is undefined behavior.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines finite-difference travel-time and amplitude modeling, interpolation between midpoint grids, and Kirchhoff reflector summation.

test_cases.description: Constant velocity grid and zero-offset midpoint traces.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sugain scale=2000 | sustrip > velocity.bin && susynvxz nx=21 nz=21 dx=100 dz=100 nt=128 dt=0.02 nxm=4 dxm=100 fxm=500 nxo=1 'ref=1:100,500;1900,500' < velocity.bin

sunull nt=21 ntr=21 | suop op=exp | sugain scale=2000 | sustrip > velocity.bin && susynvxz nx=21 nz=21 dx=100 dz=100 nt=128 dt=0.02 nxm=5 dxm=100 fxm=500 nxo=2 fxo=100 dxo=100 nxd=2 ls=1 'ref=1:100,500;1900,500' < velocity.bin
